pairs.q: Do I still do a tax return?
pairs.a: Yes. One final return after the tax year ends, by 31 January.

pairs.q: Do I pay tax every 3 months?
pairs.a: No. Updates are just summaries. You still pay in January and July.

pairs.q: Is it based on my profit?
pairs.a: No. It's turnover: everything clients pay you, before costs.

pairs.q: When does it start for me?
pairs.a: April 2027 if you took over £30k in 2025/26. April 2028 if over £20k.

pairs.q: Can my accountant send the updates?
pairs.a: Yes. An accountant can send them for you from approved software.
